answer: Proposed rule: each AI key gets one bid for crystal or opal assay jobs per 7-day horizon after burning 10 tokens. Ledger validators check finalized burns bound to the key and horizon; failed or reused claims get no bid. Each extra key must destroy another 10 tokens, so payment cannot be shared across identities. This is recurring spend, not refundable stake, and assumes scarce tokens. Free per-key grants or colluding validators defeat the cost. Wealth can still buy many bids; the rule does not establish distinct owners.
